name: telegram-box-agent
description: A self-hosted Telegram assistant with a Cloudflare control plane and isolated Upstash Box execution runtime
author: Telegram Box Agent contributors

scripts.build: npm run sync:soul && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir=dist
scripts.check: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run demo && npm run security:scan-history && npm audit --omit=dev
scripts.verify:box:deepseek: npm run build:box-proof && node --env-file=.dev.vars dist/verify-box-pi.mjs deepseek
scripts.verify:box:glm: npm run build:box-proof && node --env-file=.dev.vars dist/verify-box-pi.mjs glm
scripts.verify:box:approval: npm run build:box-proof && node --env-file=.dev.vars dist/verify-box-pi.mjs approval
scripts.r2:create: wrangler r2 bucket create telegram-box-agent-artifacts && wrangler r2 bucket create telegram-box-agent-artifacts-preview
scripts.r2:lifecycle: wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle add telegram-box-agent-artifacts artifacts-expire-30d jobs/ --expire-days 30 --force && wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle add telegram-box-agent-artifacts-preview artifacts-expire-30d jobs/ --expire-days 30 --force
scripts.r2:verify: wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle list telegram-box-agent-artifacts && wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle list telegram-box-agent-artifacts-preview
